room.drowned_lantern.title: The Drowned Lantern
room.drowned_lantern.description: The inn is low and warm and smells of peat smoke and spilled ale. The hearth is big enough to stand in. The [rumor board](rumor_board) is thick with pinned notes, and Maud’s bar runs along the back wall.
room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing, and the river slides past it the color of strong tea. A mooring post leans into the current with a [notice](notice) nailed to it. Tide marks stripe the pilings.
room.reed_path.title: Reed Path
room.reed_path.description: A narrow path presses south between tall reeds. Mud darkens the edges, where [fox prints](fox_prints) cross the path and vanish among the stems. The landing lies north.
detail.fox_prints.description: Small paw prints cross the soft mud, clear at the path's edge before the reeds swallow them.
detail.fox_prints.title: Fox prints
readable.fox_prints: The prints are small and close-set. They turn into the reeds; following them by sight ends at the first pool of dark water.
room.reed_bank.title: Reed Bank
room.reed_bank.description: The path reaches a low bank above brown fen water. [Tracks](tracks) mark the damp earth near the reeds. Firmer ground bends west under the willows. A firm path leads south to the mire crossing.
detail.tracks.description: The marks run along the bank and disappear into trampled reeds. The soft ground holds no clear story of who made them.
detail.tracks.title: Tracks
readable.tracks: Several narrow marks cross the bank toward the water. Wet reeds hide where they continue.
room.willow_shade.title: Willow Shade
room.willow_shade.description: Long willow branches hang over a strip of firm ground. The reed bank is east; south, the path passes beneath a great old oak. A [fenwort patch](fenwort_patch) grows beneath the roots.
room.drowned_oak.title: Drowned Oak
room.drowned_oak.description: A broad oak stands in dark water, its lower trunk silvered by old flood marks. The ground is still firm beneath its roots, and the willow path leads north. A firm bank leads east to the mire crossing.
room.inn_attic.title: Inn Attic
room.inn_attic.description: Dust lies thick as felt. A trunk with an iron hasp sits under the slope of the roof.
room.inn_rooms.title: Inn Rooms
room.inn_rooms.description: A narrow passage of doors under the eaves. One stands open on a bed made up tight, and a window over the green. The ceiling sags a little at the end of the passage. A plain [bed](bed) stands ready.
room.lantern_cellar.title: Lantern Cellar
room.lantern_cellar.description: Ale casks lie on their sides in cradles. The floor is gritty, and the air tastes of old beer. Rat holes gnaw the base of every wall.
room.well_lane.title: Well Lane
room.well_lane.description: A cobbled lane climbs from the landing toward the green. In the middle stands the well, with a bucket on a chain. The Drowned Lantern’s sign creaks to the east. The [well](well) has a rope and bucket for drawing clear water.
item.brass_key.room: A small [brass key] lies here, its narrow tooth glinting.
item.brass_key.description: A small brass key with a narrow tooth.
item.wool_cloak.room: A [wool cloak] hangs over the bedpost.
item.wool_cloak.description: Heavy grey wool. Rain runs off it.
item.trunk.room: An old [trunk] sits under the slope of the roof.
item.trunk.description: An old wooden trunk. Its iron hasp is dark with age.
item.tin_whistle.room: A small [tin whistle] lies in the trunk.
item.tin_whistle.description: A small tin whistle, dulled by dust.
room.village_green.title: Village Green
room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass at the heart of Ashmere. The stocks stand empty, and a [market cross](market_cross) of weathered stone marks the middle.
room.north_gate.title: North Gate
room.north_gate.description: The north gate is oak banded with iron, set in the village wall. North, a track climbs to the priory.
room.chapel_steps.title: Chapel Steps
room.chapel_steps.description: Wide stone steps, worn into dips, climb to the chapel door. An alms bowl sits on the top step.
room.chapel_nave.title: Chapel Nave
room.chapel_nave.description: The nave is cold and high. A fresco covers the east wall, and the altar is plain stone.
npc.cellar_rat.description: A small grey rat watches from beside a barrel, its whiskers twitching.
npc.cellar_rat_1.room: A [[cellar_rat_1|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
npc.cellar_rat_2.room: A [[cellar_rat_2|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
npc.cellar_rat_3.room: A [[cellar_rat_3|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
npc.cellar_rat_4.room: A [[cellar_rat_4|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
npc.cellar_rat_5.room: A [[cellar_rat_5|cellar rat]] noses among the dusty barrels.
combat.player_hit: Your blow strikes the rat squarely.
combat.player_miss: The rat darts clear of your blow.
combat.npc_hit: The rat sinks its teeth into you.
combat.npc_miss: The rat snaps at you, but finds only air.
combat.player_died: You crumple to the floor. You awaken at the shrine.
combat.npc_died: The rat gives one last shudder and lies still.
npc.maud.room: [Widow Maud] is here behind the bar, wiping a mug that is already clean.
npc.maud.description: Broad, floury, sharp-eyed. She has been widowed by the river and has not forgiven it.
dialogue.maud_offer.prompt: “Clear the five rats out of my cellar and I’ll give you the key to the storage chest upstairs.”
narration.maud.accept: You agree to clear Maud’s cellar.
dialogue.maud_turn_in.prompt: “Well? Have you dealt with those rats?”
narration.maud.done: Maud sets an iron key in your palm. “For the storage chest upstairs. You’ve earned it.”
quest.mauds_cellar.title: Maud’s Cellar
quest.mauds_cellar.active: Clear the five rats from the Lantern cellar.
quest.mauds_cellar.ready: The five cellar rats are dead. Return to Maud at the Drowned Lantern.
quest.mauds_cellar.resolved: You cleared Maud’s cellar and received the storage key.
item.cellar_key.description: An iron key, its bow worn smooth.
item.storage_chest.description: A wooden chest with an iron lock.
detail.notice.description: A weathered notice is nailed to the mooring post.
detail.rumor_board.description: Two notices are pinned to a wooden board beside the bar.
readable.notice: Keep the landing clear. Tie boats to the mooring post.
detail.rumor_board.title: Notice board
detail.lost_whistle.title: Lost tin whistle
detail.lost_whistle.description: A small handwritten notice asks about a missing whistle.
detail.cellar_help.title: Help in the cellar
detail.cellar_help.description: A notice from Maud asks for help below the inn.
readable.lost_whistle: Lost a tin whistle? Ask at the Drowned Lantern.
readable.cellar_help: Maud needs help clearing rats from the cellar. Speak to her at the bar.
detail.notice.title: Landing notice
npc.elspeth.room: [Elspeth] stands beside the mooring post, watching each boat come in.
npc.elspeth.description: A woman in a worn shawl keeps turning toward the river. One hand worries the edge of her sleeve; her eyes search every face on the landing.
dialogue.elspeth.prompt: “My boy Wren hasn’t come home. I keep thinking the next boat might bring word of him.” She gathers herself. “You’re new to Ashmere, aren’t you?”
narration.elspeth.directions: “North from here, up Well Lane,” Elspeth says. “Keep going north and you’ll reach Village Green. That’s the heart of Ashmere.”
narration.elspeth.inn: “Go north to Well Lane, then east into the Drowned Lantern. Maud keeps the inn. Speak to her at the bar; she’ll tell you what needs doing.”
narration.elspeth.wren: “My son.” Elspeth looks back at the river. “He’s always off exploring, but he should have been home by now.”
item.fox_drawing.room: A folded [fox drawing] lies near the elm's roots.
item.fox_drawing.description: A child's charcoal drawing shows a fox among tall reeds. The paper is creased and muddy. There is no name on it.
dialogue.elspeth.accept: Will you look around the Green for a sign of Wren?
narration.elspeth.accept: You agree to look around Village Green for a sign of Wren.
dialogue.elspeth_report.prompt: Elspeth watches the folded drawing in your hand.
dialogue.elspeth_report.report: I found this drawing on the Green.
narration.elspeth.report: “That could be Wren's drawing,” Elspeth says. “He was always exploring. The reeds south of the landing may be worth searching, but I can't know where he went.” “Look closely at the tracks on Reed Bank,” Elspeth says. “Follow them south. Wren is still missing.”
quest.first_lead.title: The First Lead
quest.first_lead.active: Look for a sign of Wren on Village Green.
quest.first_lead.ready: You found a fox drawing. Bring it to Elspeth at Ferry Landing.
quest.first_lead.resolved: Elspeth thought the drawing might be Wren's and suggested searching the reeds south of the landing.
quest.first_lead.failed: You could not follow the first lead.
quest.first_lead.abandoned: You set aside the search for a sign of Wren.
room.mire_crossing.title: Mire Crossing
room.mire_crossing.description: A narrow [plank](plank) spans the deepest mud. Firm banks lead north to the reeds and west beneath the old oak; the path continues south.
room.fox_hollow.title: Fox Hollow
room.fox_hollow.description: The path ends at a sheltered [hollow](hollow) among the reeds. Wren sits beside a foxlike stranger beneath the roots. The firm path returns north across the mire.
detail.plank.title: Plank
detail.plank.description: The plank is worn but steady, with a dry line across the mire.
readable.plank: The plank is worn but steady, with a dry line across the mire.
detail.hollow.title: Hollow
detail.hollow.description: Flattened grass and old fox bones mark a place where something has rested.
readable.hollow: Flattened grass and old fox bones mark a place where something has rested.
quest.missing_child.title: The Missing Child
quest.missing_child.active: Elspeth asks you to search for Wren. Study the tracks at Reed Bank, south of the landing.
quest.missing_child.lead: The tracks lead south across Mire Crossing toward Fox Hollow. Wren remains unfound.
quest.missing_child.resolved: The search for Wren has ended.
quest.missing_child.failed: The search for Wren has failed.
quest.missing_child.abandoned: You left the search for Wren.
narration.study_tracks: You kneel beside the tracks. Small footprints run south across the mire toward Fox Hollow. They give you a lead, but Wren remains unfound.
npc.wren.room: [Wren], a small boy with muddy knees, looks about him.
npc.wren.description: A small boy with muddy knees holds a reed between his fingers. His eyes are bright with curiosity.
npc.vesper.room: [Vesper] waits beside the hollow, a russet tail curled around his feet.
npc.vesper.description: A slender figure in a russet coat stands beneath the roots. His pointed face and bright amber eyes are unmistakably foxlike.
dialogue.a_vesper_meeting.prompt: “You followed the tracks,” the stranger says. “I am Vesper. And this is Wren.” The boy looks up at his name.
dialogue.a_vesper_meeting.meet_wren: “Wren, your mother is looking for you.”
narration.a_vesper_meeting: Wren nods. “I know. Vesper was showing me the fox paths.” You have found him alive, here in the hollow.
dialogue.b_vesper_riddle.prompt: Vesper lays out letter tiles. “I carry a flame behind glass. Held in a hand, I guide a traveller through darkness. What am I?”
narration.vesper_wrong: Vesper shakes his head gently. “Try the letters again. Think of the light a traveller carries.”
narration.b_vesper_riddle: “A lantern. Well answered,” Vesper says. Wren smiles. The question of returning to Elspeth still waits.
dialogue.c_vesper_answered.prompt: “You have answered my riddle,” Vesper says. “Wren may stay here with me, if he wishes. Will you carry this message to his mother at the landing?”
narration.c_vesper_answered: Vesper places his folded message in your hand. Wren stays beside him. You agree to take the message to Elspeth at Ferry Landing.
dialogue.vesper.prompt: The foxlike stranger watches you from beside the hollow.
narration.vesper: “The firm path runs north,” the stranger says. “There is no need to wait for the tide.”
dialogue.wren.prompt: The boy looks up from the reed in his hands.
narration.wren: “I never knew the fen had so many fox paths,” Wren says, turning the reed between his fingers.
quest.missing_child.met: You met Wren alive at Fox Hollow. Speak to Vesper and answer his letter-bank riddle. Wren has not returned home.
quest.missing_child.answered: Vesper accepted your answer. Speak to Wren about going home, or to Vesper about carrying a message to Elspeth while Wren stays.
item.vesper_message.description: A folded message addressed to Elspeth in a fine, slanting hand. Vesper entrusted it to you for Wren’s mother.
dialogue.c_vesper_answered.carry_message: “I’ll take your message to Elspeth. Wren can stay.”
dialogue.elspeth_return.prompt: Elspeth looks at the folded message. “You have news of Wren?”
narration.elspeth_return: Elspeth accepts Vesper’s message and reads it slowly. “He has chosen to stay,” she says. “Thank you for bringing me his word.” Wren remains with Vesper at Fox Hollow.
dialogue.elspeth_stays.prompt: Elspeth folds the message carefully. “I know where Wren is now. He has chosen to stay with Vesper.”
narration.elspeth_stays: “I will keep his message,” Elspeth says. She tucks the folded paper safely inside her shawl.
quest.missing_child.deliver: Wren has chosen to stay with Vesper. Deliver Vesper’s original message to Elspeth at Ferry Landing; if you left it behind, recover it first.
room.village_green.stays: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass at the heart of Ashmere. The stocks stand empty beside the weathered [market cross](market_cross). Wren has chosen to stay with Vesper; his message has reached his mother.
quest.missing_child.stays: Wren chose to remain with Vesper at Fox Hollow. You delivered Vesper’s message to his mother, Elspeth.
dialogue.wren_escort.prompt: Wren glances from Vesper to you. “Mother must be worried. Will you walk back to her with me?”
dialogue.wren_escort.rescue: “Come with me. I’ll take you back to Elspeth.”
narration.wren_escort: Wren joins you for the walk to Ferry Landing. Vesper keeps his folded message and watches you set out together.
dialogue.wren_rejoin.prompt: Wren looks relieved to see you. “There you are. Can we go back together now?”
dialogue.wren_rejoin.rejoin: Rejoin Wren and continue to Elspeth.
narration.wren_rejoin: Wren steps beside you again, ready to continue to his mother at Ferry Landing.
dialogue.elspeth_rescue.prompt: Elspeth catches sight of Wren beside you. She reaches toward him. “Wren?”
narration.elspeth_rescue: Wren runs into Elspeth’s arms. She holds him close. “You brought him home. Thank you.” Wren stays with his mother at the landing.
dialogue.elspeth_rescued.prompt: Elspeth keeps Wren close beside her. “He’s home. I can hardly believe it.”
narration.elspeth_rescued: Elspeth rests a hand on Wren’s shoulder. “We won’t forget what you did.”
quest.missing_child.following: Wren is walking with you. Take him to Elspeth at Ferry Landing and speak to her to complete the return.
quest.missing_child.separated: You were separated from Wren. Return to where you left him and speak to him to Rejoin before continuing to Elspeth.
quest.missing_child.rescued: You brought Wren safely to his mother, Elspeth, at Ferry Landing. He remains with her.
room.village_green.rescued: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass at the heart of Ashmere. The stocks stand empty beside the weathered [market cross](market_cross). Wren is safely back with his mother at the landing.
room.village_green.lost: The elm shades the empty green. People have heard the bell, but nobody has brought Wren home. The road toward the river stays open. The [market cross](market_cross) stands where it always has.
room.bell_tower.title: Bell Tower
room.bell_tower.description: A narrow stair climbs inside the chapel tower. Old mortar flakes from the wall. Above, daylight falls through the belfry slats; below, the nave waits in silence.
room.belfry.title: Belfry
room.belfry.description: Wind passes through the slats and over the [bell](bell), dark with age. Its rope hangs within reach. The stair leads down to the chapel.
detail.bell.title: Chapel bell
detail.bell.description: The great bell hangs from a timber crossbeam. Its rope is sound, and the clapper waits just clear of the bronze.
readable.bell: Letters worn by years circle the rim: ASHMERE. The bell can be heard across the village and out into the fen.
npc.aldric.room: [Prior Aldric] stands beside the altar, watching the open stair to the tower.
npc.aldric.description: Aldric wears a plain dark habit. His hands are ink-stained, and his gaze moves to the tower whenever the wind shifts.
dialogue.aldric.offer.prompt: “You have searched the fen,” Aldric says. “Ring the chapel bell. Its sound may reach where our voices cannot.”
narration.aldric.accept: Aldric nods toward the tower stair. “Up through the belfry. The rope is beside the bell.”
dialogue.aldric.prompt: Aldric looks up at the bell tower. “The stair is open. Take care on the steps.”
narration.aldric.bell: “It has called this village together longer than I have lived here,” Aldric says.
narration.aldric.leave: Aldric returns to his watch beneath the tower.
quest.bell.title: The Bell of Ashmere
quest.bell.active: Climb from Chapel Nave through Bell Tower to the Belfry and ring the bell.
quest.bell.ready: The bell has sounded across Ashmere.
quest.bell.resolved: You rang the chapel bell for Aldric.
quest.bell.failed: The bell quest ended without a ringing.
quest.bell.abandoned: You left the bell quest unfinished.
quest.bell.prior: You rang the chapel bell. Its first call belongs to Aldric and the priory.
narration.ring_bell: You pull the rope. The bell answers with a deep note that rolls over Ashmere and into the fen.
scene.bell_rung.bell: The bell's voice shudders through the timber around you.
scene.bell_rung.fen: Beyond the slats, the fen lies still beneath the sound.
scene.bell_rung.fox: When the last note fades, even the fox calls have gone quiet.
quest.missing_child.lost: The bell rang before you met Wren. The search has ended without bringing him home; Elspeth has not received a message or a rescue.
dialogue.elspeth_lost.prompt: Elspeth has heard the bell. She looks past you toward the river. “You haven't found him, have you?”
narration.elspeth_lost: You tell her the bell was rung before Wren was found. Elspeth lowers her eyes. “Then I'll keep watching the landing.”
narration.silence_bell: You leave the bell rope untouched. In the hush, the fox has your answer.
quest.bell.fox: You left the bell silent. The fox has your allegiance.
scene.bell_silenced.bell: The bell hangs still above Ashmere. Far below, the fen keeps its own counsel.
scene.bell_silenced.aldric: Aldric sees the untouched rope. His face goes cold. “Then you have made your choice,” he says.
room.chandler.title: Chandler
room.chandler.description: Peg keeps the chandler’s shelves in order. The well lane lies east; steps lead down to the storeroom.
room.chandler_storeroom.title: Chandler Storeroom
room.chandler_storeroom.description: Crates and empty casks line the storeroom. The chandler is upstairs.
npc.peg.description: Peg keeps careful accounts and speaks without wasting a word.
item.tithe_ledger.description: A narrow ledger lists the tithe owed to the Priory.
dialogue.peg_debt.prompt: “Aldric at the Chapel Nave is still waiting for my ledger,” Peg says.
dialogue.peg_debt.accept_on_time: Take the ledger; promise to deliver it by the second day at six.
dialogue.peg_debt.accept_late: Take the ledger; accept that only late delivery remains.
dialogue.peg_debt.elapsed: Ask about the ledger after the deadline.
narration.peg_debt.accept_on_time: Peg puts her ledger in your hands and names the second day at six as the deadline.
narration.peg_debt.accept_late: Peg puts her ledger in your hands. “It is late already, but Aldric still needs it.”
narration.peg_debt.elapsed: “The time for that ledger passed,” Peg says. She asks nothing of you.
dialogue.aldric_debt.prompt: Aldric glances at the ledger. “Is this Peg’s account?”
dialogue.aldric_debt.on_time: Give Aldric Peg’s ledger before the deadline.
narration.aldric_debt.on_time: Aldric takes the ledger and pays you ten pennies from his purse.
narration.aldric_debt.late: Aldric takes the overdue ledger without payment.
quest.chandlers_debt.title: Chandler’s Debt
quest.chandlers_debt.active: Carry Peg’s ledger directly to Aldric at the Chapel Nave before the third day at six. Payment is due only by the second day at six.
quest.chandlers_debt.ready: Bring the ledger directly to Aldric at the Chapel Nave.
quest.chandlers_debt.resolved: You delivered Peg’s ledger to Aldric.
quest.chandlers_debt.on_time: You delivered the ledger on time and received ten pennies.
quest.chandlers_debt.late: You delivered the ledger late, without payment.
narration.begin_epilogue: You pause beside the market cross and let the village settle around you.
detail.market_cross.description: The old stone cross stands where Ashmere gathers for news and trade. You can begin the epilogue here when your story is ready.
scene.epilogue_rescued_prior.1: Wren is home with Elspeth. Their voices carry across the green.
scene.epilogue_rescued_prior.2: The bell you rang still seems to echo from the priory hill. The fox calls have quieted.
scene.epilogue_rescued_prior.3: You leave the cross knowing Wren came safely through.
scene.epilogue_rescued_fox.1: Wren is home with Elspeth. Their voices carry across the green.
scene.epilogue_rescued_fox.2: The bell remains silent. The fen and its fox calls answer for themselves.
scene.epilogue_rescued_fox.3: You leave the cross knowing Wren came safely through.
scene.epilogue_stays_prior.1: Wren remains with Vesper in the fen; his message has reached Elspeth.
scene.epilogue_stays_prior.2: The bell you rang still seems to echo from the priory hill. The fox calls have quieted.
scene.epilogue_stays_prior.3: You leave the cross knowing Wren chose his own place.
scene.epilogue_stays_fox.1: Wren remains with Vesper in the fen; his message has reached Elspeth.
scene.epilogue_stays_fox.2: The bell remains silent. The fen and its fox calls answer for themselves.
scene.epilogue_stays_fox.3: You leave the cross knowing Wren chose his own place.
scene.epilogue_lost_prior.1: Wren did not return. His absence sits with the village even here.
scene.epilogue_lost_prior.2: The bell you rang still seems to echo from the priory hill. The fox calls have quieted.
scene.epilogue_lost_prior.3: You leave the cross carrying the truth of Wren’s loss.
item.torch.description: An oil-soaked wick on a sturdy handle can be lit, doused and refilled with lamp oil.
item.lamp_oil.room: [A flask of lamp oil](lamp_oil) lies here.
item.lamp_oil.description: A bottle of oil for refilling the torch. Its empty shell can still be sold.
item.satchel.description: A small satchel with room for four items.
shop.bought: Peg takes your pennies and hands you the purchase.
shop.sold: Peg takes the item and counts your pennies into your hand.
detail.fenwort_patch.title: Fenwort Patch
detail.fenwort_patch.description: A finite patch of fenwort grows under the willows. Pick one sprig at a time; a sprig dropped here can be gathered again.
narration.harvest: You gather a sprig of fenwort.
item.fenwort.room: A [sprig of fenwort] grows low among the roots.
item.fenwort.description: A small sprig of fenwort, useful to Brother Wick.
item.bandage.description: A clean strip of linen from the infirmary.
npc.wick.room: [Brother Wick] sorts linen beside the infirmary table.
npc.wick.description: Wick welcomes visitors at any hour. He will exchange three fenwort for three bandages when you hold the herbs and he has the linen. These exchanges are optional; his supplies are finite.
room.cloister.title: Cloister
room.cloister.description: Open stone arches surround a quiet courtyard. The nave is south, the public infirmary east.
room.infirmary.title: Infirmary
room.infirmary.description: Clean linen hangs above a long table. The cloister lies west.
dialogue.a_wick_offer.prompt: “Bring me three sprigs of fenwort and I will give you three bandages,” Wick says. “We can begin again immediately while the supplies last.”
dialogue.b_wick_turn_in.prompt: Wick checks your three fenwort and his three bandages.
quest.infirmary_herbs.title: Infirmary Herbs
narration.wick.accept: You agree to exchange three fenwort for three bandages with Wick.
narration.wick.exchange: Wick takes the three fenwort and places three bandages in your hand.
quest.infirmary_herbs.active: Retrieve three fenwort into your hands and return to Wick. Ground, stored or corpse-held herbs need to be recovered first.
quest.infirmary_herbs.ready: Wick can exchange your three directly held fenwort for three funded bandages.
quest.infirmary_herbs.resolved: The exchange is complete. You may explicitly accept another while you hold three fenwort and Wick has three bandages; it is optional.
quest.infirmary_herbs.abandoned: You left the optional herb exchange.
light.refueled: You refill the torch from the oil bottle.
room.well_shaft.title: Well Shaft
room.well_shaft.description: A narrow stair descends beside old [masonry](masonry). The way up returns to Well Lane.
room.well_shaft.dark: Darkness fills the shaft. The stair up leads back to Well Lane.
detail.masonry.description: Carefully fitted stones line the shaft. There is no opening in the masonry.
npc.tobin.room: [Tobin] stands beside the north gate, watching the road.
npc.tobin.description: Tobin keeps an old sword beside him. He offers immediate lessons in swords and dodge for two pennies each. Learning a skill and qualifying to use it are separate.
skill.swords.label: Swords
skill.dodge.label: Dodge
combat.block: Your shield blocks the rat’s strike.
item.rusty_sword.description: A sound old blade with rust along its edge.
item.iron_sword.description: A balanced iron blade, sharper than Tobin’s old sword.
item.wooden_shield.description: A plain wooden shield, ready for your off hand.
tobin.swords.prompt: “I can teach you swords now. The lesson costs two pennies. I will give you this rusty sword. Swords require STR at least 10 to use.”
tobin.swords.learned: Tobin accepts two pennies and teaches you swords. He gives you his rusty sword.
tobin.dodge.prompt: “I can teach you dodge now. The lesson costs two pennies. Dodge requires DEX at least 10 to use.”
tobin.dodge.learned: Tobin accepts two pennies and teaches you dodge.
room.watch_post.title: Watch Post
room.watch_post.description: An open guard room overlooks the northern arch. The [duty roster](duty_roster) hangs beside an unlocked cell and the tower stairs.
room.watch_cell.title: Watch Cell
room.watch_cell.description: The empty cell stands open. You can walk back into the Watch Post without a key.
room.gate_tower.title: Gate Tower
room.gate_tower.description: Wind passes through the low tower. The stairs lead straight down to the Watch Post.
room.east_gate.title: East Gate
room.east_gate.description: A [road sign](road_sign) stands by a flooded lane. The village green is west of you.
detail.duty_roster.title: Duty roster
readable.duty_roster: Tobin leads one short round at a time. Join him at each checkpoint. If you leave, return and Rejoin. If you die, return and Restart immediately.
detail.road_sign.description: The flooded road sign is readable.
detail.road_sign.title: Flooded road sign
readable.road_sign: The King’s Road is flooded beyond this gate and lies outside this chapter. Return west to Village Green.
quest.watch_rounds.title: Watchman’s Rounds
watch.active: Follow Tobin by ordinary exits. A departure pauses the attempt; return and Rejoin. After a fatal fall, return and Restart immediately.
watch.completed: You completed the rounds with Tobin. The watch recognizes your help.
watch.prompt: Tobin checks where the two of you stand in the rounds.
watch.started: Tobin welcomes you on the rounds. No checkpoint is earned until you walk after him.
watch.departed: Tobin takes the next leg alone. Walk the ordinary exit to join him.
watch.rejoined: Tobin waits beside you again. The next leg continues from here.
watch.restarted: Tobin begins a fresh attempt from here. Earlier checkpoint credit is cleared.
room.marsh_light.title: Marsh Light
room.marsh_light.description: Firm footing threads the reeds. A [glow](glow) hovers ahead, beyond the [reeds](reeds).
room.marsh_light.dark: Dark reeds hide the marsh. A [glow](glow) hovers above the path.
detail.glow.description: A pale glow waits just beyond the reeds. Douse any carried light, then seek the wisp.
detail.marsh_reeds.description: Dense reeds rustle in the wind.
room.old_causeway.title: Old Causeway
room.old_causeway.description: Dry stones cross the marsh. A [carved fox](carved_fox) watches the path.
detail.carved_fox.description: A fox is carved into the old stone. Its meaning is hidden.
room.tide_flats.title: Tide Flats
room.tide_flats.description: The public path ends at the edge of the tide flats. Dry stones lead back west.
npc.wisp.description: A patient pale light hovers in the still air. It shies away from a carried flame; douse your light to speak or answer.
narration.seek_wisp: You follow the glow and find a wisp waiting above the reeds.
narration.seek_wisp_failed: The glow slips from your sight. You can seek it again.
dialogue.wisp.offer: The wisp offers a riddle and a ward for its answer. Will you accept?
narration.wisp.accept: The wisp waits for your answer.
dialogue.wisp.riddle: Keep any carried light doused. I come and go, yet never leave the shore. What am I?
narration.wisp.wrong: The wisp dims. That is not the answer.
narration.wisp.correct: The wisp brightens. You learn the ward of the fen.
quest.wisp_ward.title: The Wisp’s Ward
quest.wisp_ward.active: Answer the wisp’s riddle. You may ask again immediately.
quest.wisp_ward.resolved: You answered the wisp and learned the ward of the fen.
dialogue.aldric.ward: Aldric listens when you mention the ward of the fen.
narration.aldric.ward: Aldric calls it an old marsh tradition: a promise to respect the fen, not a spell.
detail.glow.title: Marsh glow
detail.well.description: A rope and bucket hang over clear, cold well water. You can fill your own waterskins here.
detail.well.title: The well
liquid.poured: You pour into the other waterskin.
item.spare_waterskin.description: A second sturdy leather waterskin, with a pale cord around its neck. It holds four quarter-litres.
service.room.used: Maud takes your three pennies. The bed upstairs in Inn Rooms is yours to rest in.
service.meal.used: Maud takes two pennies and serves bread. You eat the meal and recover movement.
service.ale.used: Maud takes a penny and pours a serving of ale. You drink it and recover movement.
item.ale_cask.room: A small [ale cask](lantern_ale_cask) holds Maud’s ale.
item.ale_cask.description: Maud keeps this finite cask behind her counter.
detail.bed.title: Bed
detail.bed.free: A plain bed stands upstairs. Maud offers the room downstairs; ordinary rest is still available.
detail.bed.paid: You have paid Maud for this bed. You may rest here whenever you return.
service.unaffordable: The exact penny payment is unavailable.
service.already_paid: You have already paid for the bed.
room.prior_study.title: Prior Study
room.prior_study.description: Shelves flank a plain desk. A ledger of household accounts lies closed beside an inkpot.
room.spire.title: Priory Spire
room.spire.description: Wind moves around the stone crown. Ashmere roofs and the broad fen stretch below.
room.scriptorium.title: Scriptorium
room.scriptorium.description: Daylight falls across two books: [The Ward of the Fen](ward_of_the_fen) and [Bell Rites](bell_rites). Narrow desks stand ready for copying.
room.kitchen_garden.title: Kitchen Garden
room.kitchen_garden.description: Rows of kitchen herbs grow between gravel paths. Bees move through the thyme.
item.ward_of_the_fen.room: [The Ward of the Fen](ward_of_the_fen) rests on a copying desk.
item.ward_of_the_fen.description: A small bound volume titled [The Ward of the Fen](ward_of_the_fen). Its single page is written in a steady hand.
readable.ward_of_the_fen: The ward is a promise kept between the Priory and the fen. Ask Aldric how its protection is renewed.
item.bell_rites.room: [Bell Rites](bell_rites) rests on a copying desk.
item.bell_rites.description: A small bound volume titled [Bell Rites](bell_rites). Its single page is written in a steady hand.
readable.bell_rites: The Priory bell calls witness to a vow. A clear note carries the rite beyond the stone walls; the keeper tends both rope and promise.
npc.ash.room: [Novice Ash](ash) studies a scrap of writing.
npc.ash.description: Novice Ash keeps ink on his fingertips and a half-finished thought on his tongue.
dialogue.ash.prompt: The copying desks are open to anyone who wishes to learn.
npc.hale.room: [Novice Hale](hale) pauses beside the stone walk.
npc.hale.description: Novice Hale has soil on his cuffs and a patient, careful manner.
dialogue.hale.prompt: The garden feeds the Priory. Even the thyme has its place.
